title: eunox capability manifest (schemaVersion 0.2)
description: The typed, closed-vocabulary policy document eunox enforces. It is an ALLOWLIST: a request matching no capability is denied, so every grant is explicit and a misspelled key is a load error rather than a silently inert rule. This schema covers the published "0.2" grammar — the base authorization vocabulary plus the flow+effect layer (the flowLabel condition, the labelOutput directive, the effectClass and blastRadius conditions, a constraint's effect contract, the top-level effectCeiling, and ${task.*} variables). A "0.1" manifest is a strict subset: none of the flow+effect tokens is part of that revision, and the loader refuses one that uses them. This schema is an authoring aid; the loader is authoritative and enforces rules JSON Schema cannot express (glob well-formedness, effect-contract digest pins, the compensable/compensatingAction pairing, cross-condition quota-bucket collisions).

schemaVersion.description: Manifest GRAMMAR version — the dialect of fields this document is written in. Distinct from `version` (the policy content's semver) and from the eunox release version. An absent or unrecognized value is refused at load, fail-closed: a grammar the proxy may not model must never be parsed with unmodeled fields silently dropped.

name.description: Human-readable policy name, unique per logical agent. Recorded in audit records.

version.description: Policy-content version, strict three-part semver with no pre-release or build suffix. Recorded in every audit record and pinnable from a gateway config via `expectVersion`.

description.description: Optional free-text description of what this policy governs.

serverVersion.description: Optional upstream MCP server version this policy was authored against. Compared with the live server at startup by the drift check.

audience.description: Gateway mode: the JWT `aud` claim required on this route. Overrides the global --jwt-audience for the route, which remains the fallback for routes declaring none.

capabilities.description: The allowlist. Each entry grants a set of actions on a target, optionally narrowed by conditions and annotated with directives and an effect contract. An empty list denies everything.

effectCeiling.description: schemaVersion 0.2. The tool-agnostic consequence bound EVERY allowed action is additionally checked against, keyed on the action's effect properties rather than on which tool it is. It can only narrow — it runs after a constraint has already allowed the call.

flowLabelNamespaces.description: schemaVersion 0.2. The external sensitivity taxonomies this policy speaks — the namespace half of an imported "namespace:value" flow label. eunox owns the algebra and never the taxonomy, so the label VALUES stay open; declaring the namespace is the closure it can own, and it is what makes a misspelled taxonomy name a load error rather than a label that silently matches nothing. An imported label naming an undeclared namespace is refused at load. Merged as a union across multiple manifest files.

target.description: Namespaced target: "tool:<name>", "resource:<uri>", "prompt:<name>", or "system:sampling/createMessage". Tool and resource targets may use path.Match globs; '*' does not cross '/'.

actions.description: Actions granted on the target. Valid values depend on the namespace: tool -> call; resource -> read, subscribe, unsubscribe; prompt -> get; system -> allow. "*" grants every action valid for the namespace.

enforcement.description: How a denial from THIS constraint is handled. "enforce" (the default) denies; "audit" downgrades the denial to an observed, forwarded call for staged rollout. It never opens the allowlist, and never downgrades a kill-switch, JWT-intersection, or hard denial.

descriptionHash.description: Optional "sha256:<64 lowercase hex>" pin of the tool description the upstream advertises. Supported only on exact-name tool: targets. A mismatch aborts startup unconditionally.

principal.description: Scopes this constraint to requests whose validated JWT identity matches. Every listed claim must be present and match one of its patterns (AND across claims, OR within a claim). Requires JWT mode.

argumentSchema.description: Structural validation of a tool call's argument map. Valid on tool: targets only — the other namespaces carry no argument map, so one elsewhere is refused at load rather than accepted and never enforced.

effect.description: schemaVersion 0.2. What a call to this target DOES, as a declaration — never an inference from the payload. A constraint with no effect block resolves to the fail-closed default (irreversible, unquantified), which is what makes an unannotated target escalate under a ceiling.

conditions.description: Boolean predicates that must ALL hold for the call to be allowed. Evaluated at the same interception point as the allowlist match; a condition that cannot be evaluated denies.

directives.description: Post-allow obligations. redactFields mutates the response; labelOutput writes per-session information-flow state. A directive never affects the allow/deny decision.

flowLabel.description: A flow label on either of the two axes. NATIVE provenance/integrity is the closed, flat vocabulary eunox owns end to end. IMPORTED sensitivity is "namespace:value", where the namespace names an external taxonomy (Purview/MSIP/BigID) declared in the top-level `flowLabelNamespaces` and the value is that taxonomy's own class — eunox owns the algebra and never the taxonomy, so the values are open and only their shape is checked here. Both axes are flat: no lattice, no partial order. A label is a tag policy asserts, never a value inferred from content. The loader additionally rejects an imported label whose namespace this manifest did not declare, which JSON Schema cannot express.

importedFlowLabel.description: An imported sensitivity label, "namespace:value". The namespace is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens with a leading letter; the value is printable ASCII with no spaces (slugify the taxonomy's own spelling, e.g. "Highly Confidential" → "highly-confidential"). The value set is the incumbent classifier's, not eunox's, so it is unconstrained beyond that shape.

condition.description: One condition, discriminated by `type`. The vocabulary is CLOSED: an unrecognized type is a load error.

notBefore.description: RFC3339 instant before which the call is denied.

notAfter.description: RFC3339 instant after which the call is denied.

values.description: Scalar values. A STRING entry is matched as a glob, never by exact equality first. A "${task.*}" entry (schemaVersion 0.2) is a task-context variable instead: it resolves from the validated token and is compared by EXACT equality, and it must be the entire value.

afterTools.description: Tool names whose prior invocation in this session denies the call. Matched LITERALLY — a glob here never fires and would fail open, so it is refused at load.

oneOf.title: flowLabel
oneOf.description: schemaVersion 0.2. The SINK half of information-flow control: denies when the session's accumulated flow labels are not a subset of `allow`.

allow.description: The source classes this sink tolerates. An EMPTY list is valid and is the strictest sink: it admits only an unlabeled, clean-context flow.

oneOf.title: effectClass
oneOf.description: schemaVersion 0.2. Bounds the reversibility class of the call's resolved effect contract.

oneOf.title: blastRadius
oneOf.description: schemaVersion 0.2. Bounds the quantitative size of the call's effect: `max` per call, and/or a cumulative `maxTotal` summed over `windowSeconds`. A condition declaring neither bound is refused at load, and maxTotal/windowSeconds must be set together — half the pair silently disables the other half.

oneOf.title: policy
oneOf.description: Delegates a leaf predicate to an external PDP (OPA/Cedar) under the fail-closed ceiling. The engine supplies the input; an unreachable or erroring backend denies.

oneOf.title: custom
oneOf.description: A condition handled by a handler registered on the engine. Unregistered at runtime means DENY, never skip.

directive.description: One directive, discriminated by `type`. The vocabulary is CLOSED: an unrecognized type is a load error.

oneOf.title: redactFields
oneOf.description: Masks the listed dot-path fields in a tools/call result. Valid on tool: targets only. Array-index notation is refused at load: each segment is a literal object key, so an indexed segment would silently match nothing.

oneOf.title: labelOutput
oneOf.description: schemaVersion 0.2. The SOURCE half of information-flow control: asserts that this call's output carries the named native labels into the session. Valid on tool: and resource: targets — an egress is not a source.

effectClass.description: The closed reversibility vocabulary. Unannotated resolves to irreversible — the fail-closed flywheel that makes annotating a tool the thing that buys it out of maximum friction.

blastRadiusSpec.description: Quantifies a call's magnitude. Exactly one of `value` or `argument` is set; the loader rejects both and neither. A missing or unusable argument resolves to UNQUANTIFIED, which exceeds any finite bound — an action whose size cannot be established must not be treated as small.

value.description: A fixed magnitude for every call to this target.

argument.description: The call argument carrying the magnitude; a list contributes its LENGTH.

unit.description: Free-form label for reports and audit records ("usd", "rows"). Never compared — eunox models no unit algebra.

effectCase.description: One row of an argument-parameterized contract; its fields overlay the base contract when the case matches.

idempotent.description: The call can be repeated with no additional effect. It does NOT by itself make an action reversible — a repeatable outbound email is still irreversible.

compensatingAction.description: The target that reverses this one. REQUIRED for class "compensable" and refused on any other, applied to the RESOLVED effect: "compensable with nothing to compensate with" is irreversible wearing a softer label, which is exactly how an irreversible action gets waved through a consequence gate.

byArgument.description: The argument-parameterized form: effect as a STATIC decision table keyed on one argument (db.query is reversible for SELECT, irreversible for DROP). Resolved from the call's own arguments — no callout, no inference.

default.description: Applies when no case matches. ABSENT means the fail-closed default (irreversible, unquantified), not the base contract: a table that does not cover a value has not said the value is safe.

ref.description: Pins the registry contract this block was authored from, as "<contract-id>@sha256:<hex>". eunox NEVER fetches it — the decision path stays local, so a registry outage cannot change a verdict — but the loader recomputes the inline block's digest and refuses a mismatch, which is what makes it an integrity pin rather than a comment.

maxEffectClass.description: The most consequential class that passes without escalation. Absent leaves the class dimension unbounded.

maxBlastRadius.description: The largest magnitude that passes. An UNQUANTIFIED action exceeds any set bound. Absent leaves the magnitude dimension unbounded.

requireCompensation.description: Additionally demand a compensating action for any action above maxEffectClass — the third input of the consequence gate.

onExceed.description: The outcome for an over-ceiling action. "escalate" (the default) marks it as needing human approval; with no approval integration wired that resolves fail-closed to NOT FORWARDED. "deny" refuses outright with no approval path.

argumentSchema.description: A deliberately small JSON-Schema-like subset. `pattern` compiles with Go RE2 (no lookaround or backreferences) and matches UNANCHORED, as in JSON Schema — anchor with ^...$ for a security rule.

allOf.title: 0.1 is a strict subset
allOf.$comment: The flow+effect tokens were introduced by "0.2" and are not part of "0.1"; the loader refuses a 0.1 manifest that uses one, naming the revision that introduced it. Encoded here rather than only described, so an editor bound to this schema catches the most likely migration error instead of certifying a document the proxy will refuse to start on.
